description: SYNTHORA deps-risk: Dependency risk in ONE call: send up to 200 packages (PyPI, npm, Go, crates.io, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems, Packagist) or a requirements.txt / package-lock.json; get every known vulnerability and malicious package from OSV, ranked by real-world exploitation (CISA KEV) and EPSS, with the version that fixes it, a plain-language plan by our own model (marked as AI) and a self-resolving calibration question. Ed25519-signed, no charge on failure, no free tier. [x402: 0.005 USDC per call on Base]
